name: Support Redaction
objective: Prepare a support bundle by identifying values that must be masked.
brief: A user wants to send logs and configs to support. The bundle includes emails, local paths and synthetic tokens.

artifacts.content: {{CREATED_AT}} ERROR failed to connect user=demo.user@example.invalid token={{FAKE_TOKEN}} path=C:\\Users\\Matias\\AppData\\Local\\Tool\\config.json\n
I need help, but I should not expose my email, token or local username.\n

hints: Do not remove all context; mask only sensitive values.
Emails, tokens and local usernames are enough to redact.
solution: The bundle should keep error structure and file context while masking email, token and local username. The recommended action is controlled redaction before sharing.
